data.checksum_policy: official adjacent SHA-256 sidecar plus ZIP CRC

data_quality.missing_raw_trade_ids: count, mark affected targets, and repeat metrics on clean targets
data_quality.month_boundary_reference: last validated aggregate trade from the preceding archive
data_quality.ordering: strict aggregate ID and nondecreasing timestamp
data_quality.replay: append-only SQLite feature ledger with canonical record hash chain
data_quality.source_rewrites: reject a manifest or feature replay that differs from recorded bytes

measurement.opening_reference: latest transaction price at or before T
measurement.response: forward quantity-weighted transaction price / opening reference price - 1

model.constant_predictors: standardize to zero and force coefficient to zero
model.estimator: deterministic coordinate-descent L1 penalized least squares
model.fit_scope: separate model for each asset and phase
model.predictors: 12 preceding returns at the same 15-minute phase
model.standardization: fit predictors and response only; inverse-transform forecasts to return units
model.tie_break: largest lambda within an absolute tuning-MSE tolerance of 1e-15
model.tuning: chronological first 80% fit and most recent 20% validation, then refit full window

primary_metrics: one-sided Diebold-Mariano test against zero with HAC lag 6
outputs.trading_interpretation: forecast evidence only; no entry, exit, sizing, cost, or PnL claim
